dedupe_keys.name: orbitpy satellite orbit propagation coverage and contact computation

description: OrbitPy is a Python package, with a C++ core, for computing satellite orbits and what they can see: orbit propagation, sensor coverage, ground-station contact windows and eclipse periods. It builds on the propcov library and is published under the EarthObservationSimulator organisation on GitHub. It is written by the Bay Area Environmental Research Institute with funding from the NASA Earth Science Technology Office's Advanced Information Systems Technology programme. The code is available free on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 licence, at version 0.1. Caveats: it is an early research release with modest documentation, and it models orbital geometry, not link budgets or space weather effects. It can simulate revisit times and ground-station availability for Earth observation and communication constellations, which supports resilience and capacity studies of space infrastructure and the services that depend on it; a related record is Orekit, the space flight dynamics library.
